hook.evidence: 'Hey guys, welcome back to the channel! Today we are going to talk about something really interesting.' - greeting and channel context, no reason to stay.

structure.evidence: Loose facts in no build ('Honey is made by bees. Bees are very important for the planet.'), filler throughout, explanation collapses to 'honey is special', and it ends on a like/subscribe outro rather than a payoff.

clarity.evidence: Simple words, but the mechanism is ambiguous ('Also bees add stuff to it', 'honey is special'); a listener could not retell why honey lasts. Not jargon, so slightly above 1.

pace.evidence: 99 spoken words / 30 s = 3.30 wps, above the 3.2 ceiling of the 3 anchor but not in the 1 range (>180 or <40 words); no visual cues.

accuracy.evidence: 'Scientists found honey in Egyptian tombs and it was still good' stated as fact with no source or hedge; no clearly wrong claim, so not 1, but 'It has a lot of sugar... So that's why' oversimplifies the cause.

voice.evidence: Boilerplate creator voice: 'Pretty cool, right?', 'Make sure to like and subscribe', 'See you in the next video, bye!' - could be any channel.
